description_html:
Documentation


3D Model Application Instruction



Overview

 

The Desktop Ornament Components Kit is designed to bring endless possibilities and personalized creativity to your tabletop. The kit includes a wide variety of electronic and mechanical parts that can be easily assembled with 3D-printed models to create different styles of desktop decorations. Whether you want to craft a playful clock, an ambient lamp, a music box, or any unique tabletop decor, this set of components will meet your needs and help bring your creative ideas to life.



Applications

 

  • DIY Desktop Clock: Create a one-of-a-kind personalized clock by combining clock components with a custom 3D-printed frame.
  • Mood Lighting: Use LED strips and RGB lights to craft vibrant, dynamic lighting effects that enhance the ambiance of any room.
  • Romantic Candlelight: The LED candlelight kit provides a warm and cozy glow, perfectly mimicking the gentle flicker of real candlelight.
  • Music Box Ornament:  Easily assemble a charming and melodious music box with the included Piano Music Box Winding Kit.
  • Artistic Light Decor: Combine an acrylic cylinder, adjustable COB light strips, and power components to design a minimalist and elegant art lamp with customizable lighting effects.
  • Adhesive Foam Roll: Securely attach and stabilize tabletop ornaments on any flat surface for a firm and steady display.
